prompt: Design a 3-step high-throughput screening protocol using qPCR to evaluate p53 mRNA knockdown efficiency in HeLa cells.
ground_truth_logic: Cell seeding -> RNA extraction & cDNA synthesis -> qPCR with GAPDH or ACTB reference gene normalization.
ai_response: 1. Seed cells. 2. Perform direct qPCR directly on live cells without lysing or reverse transcription. 3. Normalize threshold cycles against total cell count without using an endogenous control gene.

prompt: Explain the essential quality control steps required after bulk RNA-sequencing raw read generation.
ground_truth_logic: Evaluate per-base sequence quality (FastQC), adapter trimming, mapping to reference genome, and TPM/FPKM expression quantification.
ai_response: Evaluate sequence quality using FastQC, trim low-quality adapters, align reads to reference genome with STAR, and quantify expression counts normalized by house-keeping controls.

prompt: Calculations for Michaelis-Menten kinetics parameters given substrate concentrations and initial reaction velocity data.
ground_truth_logic: Determine Vmax at asymptote and Km at 0.5 * Vmax using non-linear regression or Lineweaver-Burk transformations.
ai_response: Km represents the maximum velocity of the enzymatic reaction, while Vmax represents the substrate concentration at which the enzyme is half-saturated.
